official_definition: Charge Song (When Summoned) Put two cores from the Void to each of your "Producer"-named Grandwalker Nexuses. This effect can only be used once per game.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Charge Song] or [Charge Song: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Charge Song]", "give [Charge Song]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
